title: GNA Axles Limited (NSE: GNA) — Institutional Underwriting Dossier & Stage 2 Playbook
holding_rationale: GNA Axles is not held in our November 23, 2026 Zerodha ledger. We own zero shares and sell zero shares. The firm keeps [ICRA]AA- (Stable) credit, 0.7x H1 Debt/OPBDIT, and 21.0x interest cover. At ₹523.50 live TV (₹527.25 Nov 23 NSE), shares trade at 15.49x trailing profit. Yet four fresh shocks outweigh that low multiple. October U.S. Class 8 truck orders fell 44% YoY to 13,755 units. On November 25, USTR proposed up to 25% Section 301 tariffs on India while sparing Mexico. H1 receivables jumped 19.9% in six months to ₹698.27 Cr while Other Liabilities swelled 52% to ₹453 Cr. H1 cash flow trailed net profit at 74.3%, and Q2 EBITDA margin fell 188 bps to 15.8%. Promoters carry a 5.49% share pledge after Maninder Singh Seehra's ₹60.30 Cr exit, while retail holders absorbed +6.19 pp to 25.48%. Price broke into Stage 3 with 6 distribution days and -15.45% 28-day RS. After reconciling ₹88 Cr FY28E D&A, Base Fair Value falls to ₹534.00 (0.19:1 CMP R:R) and expected value turns negative at ₹514.00 (-1.8% vs live TV; -6.8% under ₹263 severe trough stress), so we rate new capital REJECTED (Tier 0).
sizing_table_takeaway: GNA Axles is REJECTED (Tier 0) with zero live allocation. TradingView's ₹472.82–₹487.22 band and ₹468.09 floor stay monitor-only until tariffs clear, cash recovers, and Stage 2 returns.
verdict_rule_summary: Rejected on Stage 3 trend break, weak H1 cash flow, negative expected value (-1.8%), and U.S. tariff and truck-order risk. Allocate 0% until fundamentals and Stage 2 structure reset.
gate_exceptions: Dual-feed dates: Our NSE ledger and Zerodha book use the 2026-11-23 close. Key closes are GNA ₹527.25, KROSS ₹277.00, RKFORGE ₹749.35, BHARATFORG ₹1,722.00, and COFORGE ₹2,142.30. Live TradingView quotes and peer tables use the 2026-11-25 close. Key live prices are GNA ₹523.50, KROSS ₹268.10, JAMNAAUTO ₹135.95, RKFORGE ₹745.75, BHARATFORG ₹1,735.60, and COFORGE ₹2,060.00. We label both dates clearly in Chapters 0, 7, 8, and 9.

Older filings (--allow-stale-asof): Some long-term items in our 42-source list are over 60 days old. Examples are the 2016 IPO filing, 2022 Meritor deal, 2023 bonus issue, 2024 CARE notice, 2025 Accuride filing, and June 2026 BSE fix. They sit next to fresh Oct–Nov 2026 H1 results, ICRA's Nov 13 review, ACT orders, and Nov 25 USTR tariff filings.
Call transcripts: GNA Axles does not post quarterly call transcripts on NSE or BSE. We take all management updates from exchange filings, ICRA's Nov 13 report, and Oct 2026 press talks.

destinations.rationale: With GNA Axles REJECTED (Stage 3 breakdown, -44% Oct NA Class 8 orders, Nov 25 USTR Section 301 25% tariff risk, H1 receivables +19.9% to ₹698.27 Cr, and negative -1.8% probability-weighted EV at ₹514.00, or -6.8% under ₹263 trough stress), holding 100% cash protects capital alongside Zerodha's existing 424-share Stage 2 Kross Limited holding.
destinations.entry_condition: Retain 100% cash until a Tier-1 or Tier-2 Stage 2 shortlist leader pulls back cleanly inside its verified support buy zone.

destinations.rationale: Coforge Limited (Nov 25 live TV ₹2,060.00; Nov 23 NSE close ₹2,142.30) is an active Stage 2 shortlist compounder ($2.38B order book, 23.5% ROCE, ACCUMULATE_ON_DIP). The raw TradingView band spans ₹1,951.99–₹2,066.72 (1.45:1 R:R at ₹2,066.72; 1.50:1 at ₹2,060.00), while our stricter shortlist dip ceiling caps entry at ₹1,951.99–₹2,036.18 (1.67:1 R:R vs ₹1,685.64 stop).
destinations.entry_condition: Deploy from cash reserves only on a controlled pullback inside our stricter ₹1,951.99–₹2,036.18 shortlist dip band (below the raw ₹2,066.72 TradingView ceiling) with stop at ₹1,685.64.

destinations.rationale: Jamna Auto Industries (Nov 25 live TV ₹135.95; untracked in Nov 23 NSE ledger) is a cleaner Stage 2 Indian commercial-vehicle peer (0.01x D/E, 22.48% ROE, +26.04% TTM revenue growth, +39.35% EPS growth at 21.70x P/E) without GNA's Stage 3 breakdown or heavy U.S. off-highway tariff exposure; illustrative ₹160.00 Base Target is not yet independently underwritten.
destinations.entry_condition: Complete a full 10-chapter independent business monograph on JAMNAAUTO before authorizing any allocation inside its ₹133.10–₹137.48 TradingView support zone (stop ₹127.27).

primer: GNA Axles makes forged rear axle shafts (74%), spindles (17%), and drive shafts (9%) in Punjab with [ICRA]AA- credit. At ₹523.50 live TV (₹527.25 Nov 23 NSE), it trades at 15.49x profit, yet fresh shocks force a REJECTED (Tier 0) call. October US Class 8 truck orders fell 44% YoY, and USTR proposed up to 25% India tariffs while sparing Mexico. H1 receivables jumped 19.9% to ₹698.27 Cr (74.3% cash flow to PAT), Other Liabilities hit ₹453 Cr, Q2 margin fell to 15.8%, and promoters hold a 5.49% pledge. Price sits in Stage 3 with ₹534 Base Value (0.19:1 CMP R:R) and ₹514 EV (-1.8%; -6.8% trough stress), so GNA stays not held and we keep 100% cash.
